high_level: Do NOT run any migration automation until operator review of destructive files.
Validate documented sidecars using their provided validation commands (run on operator host).
For manual sidecars that are additive-only (CREATE IF NOT EXISTS, CONCURRENT INDEX), run a psql dry-run in transaction then apply after review.
For any file in 'destructive_files', open a PR and attach a rollback plan + data export; operator must approve before applying.
operator_checks: Run the sidecar's validationCommand from this report (where provided).
Dump affected tables (pg_dump --data-only --table=...) before any ALTER/TYPE changes.
If changing identity columns or types (integer <-> uuid), prepare a backfill/mapping plan and test on staging first.
